title: Concept: MD5 selected by name (elixir) — review required
description: In elixir, naming MD5 (:crypto.hash(:md5, data)) requests a broken digest. Name-selected digests hide inside factory calls, so reviewers must check the string, not just the call. The elixir-specific remedy is selecting :crypto.hash(:sha256, data).
applicability: elixir codebases selecting digests by name; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Same as any MD5 use: forged digests where security is assumed; LOW default severity, raised when the digest guards trust.
